verdict.rationale: A native mobile app is a fair question for a project-management SaaS like Basecamp, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions a native iOS or Android app, or mobile parity with the desktop and web experience. The documented features (to-dos, card tables, the keyboard navigation shortcuts, the CLI and API) are not evidence of a mobile app.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can manage my tasks from a full-featured native mobile app without missing desktop functionality
